CLIP (with atom IDs): E13.014 | 00:31.00-00:34.00 | CAM | Low angle on Corin framed against the lighthouse beam.
E13.015 | 00:31.40-00:33.80 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (O.S., nervous, cold) | "Take the girl to the cells until morning."
E13.016 | 00:34.00-00:39.00 | CAM | Slow push-in on Corin as the lamp flickers behind them.
E13.017 | 00:37.50-00:39.00 | SFX | Thunder cracks over the harbour.
E13.018 | 00:39.00-00:43.00 | CAM | Over-the-shoulder shot from the Mayor toward Selene.
E13.019 | 00:39.20-00:43.00 | ACT | Selene kneels on the slick quay boards.
E13.020 | 00:39.40-00:42.44 | DLG | WIDOW HALLORAN (venomous, cold) | "Expose me and her father hangs beside me."
E13.021 | 00:43.00-00:47.00 | CAM | Close-up on the Mayor's hands gripping the rail.
E13.022 | 00:43.40-00:46.80 | DLG | CORIN (protective, calm) | "Marry me at dawn, and no one will dare touch you."
E13.023 | 00:47.00-00:52.00 | CAM | Low angle on the widow framed against the lighthouse beam.
E13.024 | 00:47.40-00:50.44 | DLG | SELENE (venomous, cruel) | "A lamp-keeper's girl in my mother's lace? Never!"
E13.025 | 00:52.00-00:58.00 | CAM | Slow push-in on the widow as the lamp flickers behind them.
E13.026 | 00:58.00-01:02.00 | CAM | Medium two-shot of Mara and the Mayor, the space between them charged.
E13.027 | 00:58.40-01:01.06 | DLG | SELENE (sweet, shrill) | "Search her pockets. She is a thief!"
KEY REVEALS OF THE SHOW: R01 (E1): [mock] Mara is accused of theft at her sister's betrothal feast until a hooded harbourmaster speaks for her
R02 (E2): [mock] The harbourmaster is revealed as Lord Corin Ashvale, thought drowned, and offers Mara a bargain
R03 (E3): [mock] On the wedding morning a poisoned cup forces Corin to choose between justice and Mara's family
R04 (E4): [mock] Selene spreads a rumour that Mara lit a false light to wreck a ship
R05 (E5): [mock] Tobin the ferryman reveals what he saw on the night of the feast
R06 (E6): [mock] The council votes to take the lighthouse from Mara
R07 (E7): [mock] Corin's past returns on a ship flying a black pennant
R08 (E8): [mock] Mara discovers her father's logbook hidden in the lamp room
